svg.title: The fundamental theorem of calculus bounds the difference expression by the corresponding 2k-th derivative of the smooth separated correlation. Fatou’s lemma as h →0 gives the moment of |pj|2k. The same argument for moved word clusters uses their actual positive time gaps. For a cluster collapsed in the i direction this yields, for some finite D, C depending on the word and k, Z e−tE|pj|2k dνA i ≤Ct−D, 0 < t ≤1. (RT3)
